Synopsis:
The trial of the Murder Tribunal culminates in the Baptism of Blood, in the abattoir. The Tribunal will have either abducted Valeria, the Hollyphant detective, and chained her up here in order to be sacrificed, or she is already dead and you will just need to bathe in her blood.

Cluster Contexts:
- LOW_MurderTribunal_Sarevok_BloodBaptism.json: This exchange occurs at the climax of the Murder Tribunal’s trial — the Baptism of Blood in the abattoir — where the Tribunal has either abducted Valeria (the Hollyphant detective) and chained her for sacrifice, or she has already been killed and her blood is to be used in the ritual. Sarevok Anchev, speaking as the tribunal’s ceremonial voice, invokes the player’s Bhaal‑blood and urges the player to spill the celestial’s blood to be “reborn,” and the player line shown accepts that demand. Off‑screen this is the late‑game “point of no return” before the Netherbrain confrontation, so nearby companions and prior choices (Orpheus’s fate, any Githyanki presence, the Netherstones/tadpole status) will likely interject and make this choice consequential for endings and party relationships. The sample dialogue is one possible branch — other outcomes can involve refusing, rescuing Valeria, or disrupting the ritual.
- LOW_MurderTribunal_AD_Baptism_Cultists.json: During the Baptism of Blood at the Murder Tribunal, numerous cultists will appear in the background, ritualistically chanting while the ritual goes on.
- LOW_MurderTribunal_AD_Baptism_Cultists_Combat.json: During the Baptism of Blood at the Murder Tribunal, numerous cultists will appear in the background, ritualistically chanting while the ritual goes on. If we attack them though, they will start doing this chant instead, on the first general combat turn.
- LOW_MurderTribunal_Sarevok_Trial.json: CINE ARTIST - PLEASE CONTACT WRITER RE. STRUCTURE - IT'S NOT THAT BAD, PROMISEDialog with Sarevok and his Murder Tribunal - will begin when approaching the Murder Tribunal in an underground area beneath Baldur's Gate. Sarevok will judge whether the player is worthy of receiving the title of "Unholy Assassin" - or tell the court to attack if we are deemed unworthy. If this part of the trial succeeds, the Tribunal will move on to the "Baptism of Blood" ritual (LOW_MurderTribunal_Sarevok_BloodBaptism).
- LOW_MurderTribunal_AD_Sarevok_OnDeath.json: Death AD for Sarevok at the Murder Tribunal. Sarevok is presiding over the Murder Tribunal to judge Bhaalists who aspire to become Unholy Assassins. He will react differently, depending on how far the player has advanced in to the Murder Tribunal.

Dialogue Excerpts (up to 3 samples, ordered):
Sample 1:
- Sarevok Anchev: Come, child of Bhaal. Offer thanks unto your father for your birth, and in so doing, be reborn anew. (node 76)
- Sarevok Anchev: Slaughter this celestial being. Spill its blood into the void and through eradication of its goodness, be exalted. (node 79)
- Player: I will sacrifice the creature to Bhaal. (node 22)

context: This exchange takes place at the climax of the Murder Tribunal’s trial — the Baptism of Blood in the abattoir — where the Tribunal has either abducted Valeria (the Hollyphant detective) and chained her for sacrifice or she has already been killed and her blood is to be used in the ritual. Sarevok Anchev is presiding, invoking the player’s Bhaal‑blood and urging them to spill the celestial’s blood as part of the rebirth ceremony; the shown player line accepts that demand. Numerous cultists chant in the background (and can react or switch to combat if attacked), and this scene follows the earlier judgment phase of the Tribunal. Off‑screen this is a late‑game, point‑of‑no‑return moment — nearby companions and prior choices (Orpheus’s fate, any Githyanki presence, Netherstones/tadpole status) will affect subsequent consequences and endings.
